BrochureContent.Content:
Situated in the highly regarded area of Dundalk Mount Hamilton, this attractive family home enjoys a convenient location close to Dundalk town centre, local schools, shops, sporting facilities, and excellent transport links including the M1 motorway. The property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout and is ideal for first-time buyers, growing families, or investors seeking a quality home in a mature residential setting.

The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, spacious living room, sitting room, fully fitted kitchen downstairs shower room and Sunroom 3 generously sized bedrooms, and a family bathroom. The interior is presented in excellent condition, with an abundance of natural light creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout.

Externally, the property benefits from private off-street parking to the front and a secure enclosed rear garden, providing an ideal space for outdoor entertaining, family activities, or relaxation. Its convenient location offers easy access to a wide range of amenities, including schools, retail centres, restaurants, public transport services, and recreational facilities.

Dundalk's excellent road and rail connections make commuting to both Dublin and Belfast straightforward, while nearby coastal and countryside attractions provide an excellent quality of life for residents. Properties in this established neighbourhood are consistently sought after, making this an excellent opportunity to acquire a home in a desirable location.
